title: In-Memory & Distributed Event Manager
description: The @nestjs-yalc/event-manager package provides a unified event bus for NestJS microservices. It bridges local, process-level event emitters (built on Node.js EventEmitter2) with external distributed messaging brokers (such as Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ), providing transactional event delivery, wildcard topic subscriptions, and type-safe payload dispatches.
